description: Service-skills runtime (Claude): inject the service catalog at session start (cataloger.py), enforce expert-skill activation when a service territory is touched (skill_activator.py), and flag documentation drift after edits (drift_detector.py). All three no-op cheaply when the project has no service-registry, so they are safe to wire in every repo. Each command wraps python3 in an inline `sh -c` fail-open guard: if the machinery script is missing (fleet migration transient, wiped hooks tree during install, path drift) or crashes, the hook exits 0 with no output. These are discovery helpers, not safety gates — a missing helper must never brick Read/Write/Edit/Glob/Grep/Bash (xtrm-d3qud).
